t: What Plant Disease Identification Database Is All About
title: What Plant Disease Identification Database Is All About
description: Plant disease diagnosis reads symptoms: yellow halos around leaf spots suggest bacteria, powdery white coating means powdery mildew, and wilting with brown vascular tissue points to Fusarium. The disease triangle rules: susceptible host + virulent pathogen + favorable environment = disease. Irish potato famine (Phytophthora infestans, 1840s) killed a million — identification and response are food security. This database is the complete plant disease: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
